name: Manual quote-level amount-based (line-level) discount
what_it_tests: A manual fixed-amount discount entered at quote/line level reduces net for an eligible (non-LastTransaction, amend/add/null, non-derived) line; e.g. $5k off a $50k line
proc_mechanism: Manual Quote Level Amount-Based (Line-Level); Manual Quote Level Discount gate (ItemPricingSource NotEquals 'LastTransaction' AND (Amend OR Add OR action IsNull) AND (ItemIsDerived IsNull OR =false))
expected_behavior: Net = list - entered amount; ItemNetTotalPrice recomputed
test_setup: New/Amend non-derived line, ItemDiscountAmount/Manual_Discount_Amount set ($5k off $50k), Qty=2

prior_run.actual: After Force-reprice (isSuccess=true): NetUnitPrice=45000 (=50000-5000), NetTotalPrice=90000 (=45000*2), TotalPrice=90000, DiscountAmount=5000, ListPrice=UnitPrice=50000, TotalLineAmount=100000 (list extended, pre-discount). Net fields carry the discount.
prior_run.notes: V21 gate 'Manual Quote Level Discount' (ListContainer56 AdvancedListFilter: ItemPricingSource!=LastTransaction AND (Add OR Amend OR action IsNull) AND ItemIsDerived null/false) passed for this New non-derived line. Step 'Manual Quote Level Amount-Based (Line-Level)' (ManualDiscount BKM, AdjustmentType=Amount, AdjustmentValue=ItemDiscountAmount, InputUnitPrice=NetUnitPrice) applied per-unit $5k -> NetUnitPrice 45000, Subtotal/ItemNetTotalPrice 90000.
